message.content: {"decision":"REVISE","issues":[{"issue_id":"kinetochore_attachment_anchor_mismatch","severity":"major","description":"Assembly/global relations attach kinetochore_A/B to the chromatid 'center' anchor (i.e., the centromeric constriction point at index 2), but the microtubule constraints 'left_attachment_measured'/'right_attachment_measured' require the microtubule 'end' to coincide with the kinetochore center. The kinetochore centers are at x=±0.285 while the chromatid 'center' anchors are at x=±0.22, so the connect relation target_anchor does not match the actual kinetochore object; the drawn link (pole->kinetochore) and the declared attachment relation (kinetochore->chromatid 'center') use inconsistent endpoints. This is a schematic geometry-vs-identity bookkeeping defect, not a molecular-shape claim, but it can teach wrong attachment points. Repair: make chromatic attachment relation target the 'kinetochore_site' anchor (index 2) and keep kinetochore centers coincident with that site.","root_cause_stage":"SCENE_IR","target_objects":["kinetochore_A","kinetochore_B","sister_A","sister_B"],"target_events":["metaphase"],"repair_scope":"relations/anchors only; assets and event ordering preserved","acceptance_criteria":["kinetochore_A/B centers coincide with sister_A/B 'kinetochore_site' within tolerance","microtubule ends coincide with kinetochore centers after metaphase","relation target_anchor consistent across assembly and global relations"]},{"issue_id":"spindle_checkpoint_not_represented_as_gate","severity":"minor","description":"F5 establishes the spindle assembly checkpoint near end of metaphase as a gate before anaphase separation.
